published_ranges._nozzle_by_speed: 255C full melt up to 6 mm3/s; 275C full melt up to 12 mm3/s, up to 24 mm3/s possible with lower interlayer strength (EX12 blog)
published_ranges._bed: 80+C (product page; EX12 blog recommends 80C, warping seen at 70C)
published_ranges._notes: Product page: nozzle 255+C, 'We print up to 275 C, but 255 C is a good compromise'; start from Generic PETG or PCTG profile. Avoid very low volume rates at 275C (inclusions at 2 mm3/s). Can build up on nozzle. No density published.
